svg.text: Can AI win the $1M Netflix Challenge
Score progress by calendar date · lower RMSE is better
PROBE MODELS, BLEND CV + QUALIFYING AUDIT
Unconnected audits: gold square = own training; violet diamond = public bank. Recovered labels; Probe CV uses different rows.
Lower overall RMSE promotes a candidate; the record line follows successive best scores.
Filled cyan: new record Hollow gold: promoted against its control, not a new record
Recorded experiment order · shared original-Probe rows · historical reports and original decisions preserved
Current own-training best: 0.8599597 on different known-ProbeX rows.
Best own qualifying audit: 0.8614777 / 0.8624021 · 9.4591% on the worse group; 10% target missed.
